items.title: France's credit outlook cut to negative by S&P, economy minister calls it 'warning'
items.summary: Rating agency S&P Global is keeping France's sovereign rating at A+ but downgrading its outlook from stable to negative. The economy minister calls this 'a very clear signal that we must have a budget'.View on euronews

items.title: S&P Revises Outlook on France’s Credit Rating to Negative From Stable
items.summary: The decision paves the way for a rating downgrade as mounting public debt and political uncertainty threaten the country’s finances.

items.title: Anthropic short interest climbs as IPO lockup expiry nears
items.summary: Investing.com -- Short sellers have been building positions in Anthropic since the artificial intelligence company went public on November 18, with the number of shares on loan rising to around 55 million, equal to 0.42% of total shares outstanding, according to S&P Global data.

items.title: George Soros and 8 Other Big Funds Sold S&P Global Last Quarter, While 12 Bought. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 12 bought S&P Global and 9 sold it, George Soros’ fund among the sellers. The buyers put far more money behind the stock: Evergreen Quality Fund’s add alone was bigger than all nine sales combined.

items.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights CrowdStrike, Lockheed Martin, S&P Global, The Eastern and AmeriServ Financial
items.summary: CrowdStrike and Lockheed Martin outperform their respective industries, while S&P Global faces financial risks despite promising long-term growth drivers.

items.title: Billionaire Chris Hohn’s TCI Has 30% of Its $49.6 Billion Stock Portfolio in GE Aerospace
items.summary: One of the market's most concentrated funds just parked nearly a third of its money in a single industrial name, and the stock has barely moved this year. What does that bet reveal, and what should an ordinary retirement saver copy?

items.title: NVIDIA Stocks Fall 3.91% as S&P Puts AA Rating on Downgrade Watch
items.summary: A governance review after Jensen Huang's exit and return now threatens a one-notch cut, while Moody's keeps its Aa1 rating steady.

items.title: S&P’s NVIDIA Warning is Backward Looking Governance Theater That Gives Everyone an Opportunity to Buy at $150
items.summary: NVIDIA lost its CEO, drew a credit warning, and watched its stock slide nearly a third in a month. So why does one investor keep buying more every week, and which three numbers convinced him the real story lies elsewhere?
